title: Best Korean BBQ in Seoul 2026: From ₩10,000 to ₩100,000
description: The definitive guide to Korean BBQ in Seoul — from affordable neighborhood joints to premium wagyu restaurants. Every budget, every cut.
content:
Korean BBQ (구이, gui) is more than a meal — it's a social ritual. Meat grilled over charcoal or gas at your table, surrounded by banchan (side dishes), wrapped in lettuce with garlic and ssamjang paste. Seoul does it better than anywhere.

Budget BBQ: Under ₩20,000/person

Mapo Galmaegisalgeori (마포 갈매기살거리)

An entire street dedicated to pork skirt meat (galmaegi-sal) near Mapo station. The cheapest quality BBQ in the city. Local workers fill these places at lunch and dinner.

Price: ₩12,000-16,000/portion | Metro: Mapo, Line 5

Sinchon Area Samgyeopsal

University area means student-friendly prices. Three-layer pork belly (samgyeopsal) restaurants cluster around Sinchon Station. Some open until 4AM.

Mid-Range BBQ: ₩20,000-50,000/person

Palsaik Samgyeopsal (팔색삼겹살) — Multiple Locations

Eight different marinades for pork belly — curry, wine, soybean paste, pine needles, and more. A brilliant concept executed well. Popular with tourists for good reason.

Maple Tree House (메이플트리하우스)

Hanwoo (Korean beef) specialist. Located in Itaewon. English menu. Outstanding quality for the price.

Premium BBQ: ₩50,000-100,000+/person

Chadolbaegi & Hangjeongsal Specialists in Gangnam

Thinly sliced brisket (chadolbaegi) and neck (hangjeongsal) at premium Gangnam spots uses 1++ grade Hanwoo — the same grading system as Japanese Wagyu. The marbling is extraordinary.

💡 BBQ Etiquette: The most junior person at the table traditionally grills for everyone. Pour drinks for others before yourself. Don't pour your own drink — let someone else do it.

What to Order Beyond the Meat

  • Doenjang jjigae — Fermented soybean paste stew. Always order this.
  • Cold noodles (naengmyeon) — Perfect finish to a heavy BBQ meal
  • Makgeolli or soju — The natural BBQ drink pairing
🏨

Stay in Gangnam for Restaurant Access

Gangnam has the highest density of premium restaurants. Central location on Agoda.
